source: Agricultural Research Center, Rice Research Department product catalogue
extraction_method: Manually curated from the public ARC catalogue listing; not a live scraper.
limitations: ARC catalogue values describe published cultivar traits and are not guaranteed farm outcomes.
The catalogue listing is not an annual approved-seed availability list.
The ARC catalogue provides no local irrigation volumes or cultivar-specific water requirements in this extract.
The ARC catalogue pages conflict for Sakha 109 yield and plant type; those disputed traits were not imported.
Giza 184 appears in the catalogue without a trait profile and is not included in this extract.
unit_note: Published yields are stored in tonnes per hectare as shown by the ARC catalogue.
